Its platform helps companies run safer, more efficient and more sustainable operations at scale. Role overview You will build and run cohort-based pipeline for our enterprise sales teams: shortlist the right accounts, create the touchpoints, and keep them engaged through campaigns, content and events until they turn into qualified opportunities. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who already uses AI as a daily working tool. What you will own Cohort pipeline: build target account cohorts with Sales and own the touchpoint plan for each, from first contact to qualified lead. Campaigns: plan and run multi-channel campaigns across email, LinkedIn, webinars and paid digital, and own the numbers from outreach to MQL. Content: create blogs, case studies, one-pagers, newsletters and sales collateral that turn product features into clear business outcomes. Events: run events and webinars end to end, from logistics and vendor coordination to post-event follow-up that converts into pipeline. AI-led execution: use AI daily for account research, copy, personalisation, repurposing and reporting, and build repeatable workflows that make the team faster. Marketing operations: keep CRM and automation data clean, and manage the website and landing pages with basic SEO. Reporting: track leads, MQLs, CTR, conversion and cost per lead, and share weekly insights tied to pipeline and revenue. Enablement and market watch: work with Sales and Account Management on decks and customer stories, and track competitors and mobility and enterprise SaaS trends. What we are looking for 1-3 years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in SaaS or enterprise services; a bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications or a related field (MBA is a plus). Proven dexterity with AI tools in real marketing work, such as research, content, personalisation and automation, with examples you can show us. A hands-on self-starter who takes work from brief to delivery without being chased and owns the outcome. Strong written and verbal English, with the ability to turn product features into business benefits. Working knowledge of a CRM or marketing automation tool (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho or similar), LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads and email platforms. Comfort with Excel or Google Sheets and GA4, and the ability to manage several projects at once. Good to have Experience in mobility, transportation, HR-tech or workplace technology; exposure to ABM and event marketing; multi-region campaign experience; basic design skills in Canva or Figma. What success looks like (first 6-12 months) Consistent monthly pipeline contribution from the cohorts and campaigns you run. Every cohort has a live touchpoint plan, with engagement tracked account by account. On-time delivery of the content and collateral calendar. At least two events or webinars executed smoothly, with follow-up that converts. Clear reporting that links marketing activity to leads, pipeline and revenue. At least two AI-driven workflows adopted by the team, with measurable time saved.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Designation: Digital Marketing Manager Function: Marketing & Business Growth Location: Gurugram, Haryana Time: 10:00 AM To 7:00 PM Experience: 5+ Years Work Model: Full-time, work from office only (6 Days WFO) Reporting To: CMPO / Marketing Leadership 
 About Company: Our Client is focused on integrated hearing, communication and specialised care services. Its portfolio includes hearing assessments and hearing aids; speech, language, voice and swallowing therapy; sleep diagnostics and CPAP/APAP solutions; and tinnitus assessment and personalised management. 
 2. Role Objective Own company's in-house paid digital acquisition engine and deliver m easurable patient leads, clinic visits and revenue across Hearing, Speech & Communication, Sleep and Tinnitus. Doctor referrals are expected to remain the largest lead source, with digital marketing developed as the second-largest source. 
 The role is accountable for acquiring patients within permissible Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) limits while improving Lifetime Value (LTV) through repeat engagement, cross-service discovery and appropriate re-engagement. 
 Paid media execution will be managed in-house by this role. Organic search, SEO, local SEO and GEO execution will be delivered through an external agency; the Digital Marketing Manager will own the brief, priorities, coordination, quality control, performance review and business outcomes for that agency. 
 3. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Paid Media & Performance Marketing In-house Ownership Plan, execute, optimise and scale paid campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads and other relevant platforms, managing campaigns hands-on rather than relying on an agency. Build service-wise and location-wise acquisition plans for Hearing, Speech & Communication, Sleep and Tinnitus, aligned to clinic capacity and business priorities. Manage campaign budgets, audience and keyword strategy, bidding, creatives, lead forms, WhatsApp campaigns, remarketing and landing-page testing. Track lead quality and the full conversion funnel, not just platform-reported leads; reconcile campaign data with CRM and clinic outcomes. Maintain CAC within approved/permissible limits by service, channel and clinic. Pause, fix or scale campaigns based on verified downstream conversion and economics. Run structured experiments across audiences, messaging, offers, formats and landing pages; document learnings and scale proven combinations. Work with clinic, sales and lead-management teams to improve speed-to-lead, contactability, appointment booking, attendance and conversion. Ensure campaign setup, conversion events, naming conventions, UTMs and budget controls are accurate and consistently maintained. 
 B. Organic Search, Local SEO & GEO Agency Management Own the organic growth roadmap and translate business priorities into clear monthly briefs, deliverables and KPIs for the appointed agency. Set priorities for technical SEO, service and location pages, keyword strategy, content optimisation, internal linking, structured data and website health. Oversee local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation across clinics, including accurate service/location information, review processes and local enquiry visibility. Guide content priorities around patient symptoms, diagnostic needs, treatment options and high-intent service searches; coordinate clinical review where required. Set GEO priorities to improve comoany's discoverability and credible representation in AI-powered search and answer platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Review agency recommendations, implementation quality and reporting; challenge vanity metrics and connect organic/GEO work to qualified traffic, enquiries and clinic-level outcomes. Track organic leads, non-branded search visibility, relevant keyword performance, local actions, AI mentions/citations where measurable, and assisted conversions. Coordinate with the website/technology team and agency to resolve technical issues and ensure tracking, landing pages and lead capture work correctly. 
 C. Website Conversion & Lead Funnel Improve visitor-to-enquiry and landing-page conversion through clear service messaging, calls to action, simple forms, click-to-call and WhatsApp journeys. Analyse drop-offs across Lead Contacted Appointment Clinic Visit Assessment/Test Purchase/Therapy Revenue. Partner with the technology and operations teams to ensure reliable lead routing, source tagging, CRM integration and follow-up workflows. Use retargeting and re-engagement for eligible unconverted leads, with appropriate consent and privacy safeguards . 
 D. LTV, Retention & Patient Re-engagement Work with clinical and clinic teams to identify ethical, clinically appropriate opportunities for repeat visits, follow-up services and cross-service discovery. Develop segmented communication and re-engagement journeys for existing patients and unconverted enquiries, subject to consent and applicable privacy requirements. Measure repeat engagement and revenue contribution where data is available; recommend initiatives that improve LTV without compromising patient trust or clinical judgement. Track CAC and LTV together to guide budget allocation and assess the quality and long-term value of acquired patients. 
 E. Analytics, Attribution & Reporting Maintain a consolidated dashboard for spend, leads, qualified leads, appointments, clinic visits, conversions, revenue, CAC and LTV indicators. Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel/Conversions API where appropriate, UTMs and CRM reporting. Review performance by service, channel, campaign, clinic and geography; distinguish platform-reported results from verified CRM and business outcomes. Deliver weekly performance updates, monthly business reviews and clear action plans covering gaps, tests, budget shifts and scaling decisions. Account for assisted conversions and repeat journeys where feasible; document attribution limitations rather than overstating certainty. 
 F. Content, Creatives & Brand Coordination Develop campaign briefs and content requirements for designers, internal teams and the organic agency, ensuring alignment with company's brand guidelines. Coordinate service-specific messaging, short-form videos, doctor-led education, patient-friendly explainers and conversion-focused creatives. Ensure healthcare claims are evidence-based, clinically reviewed where necessary and compliant with applicable advertising and patient communication requirements. 
 G. Stakeholder & Agency Management Work closely with the CMPO, clinic operations, sales/lead-management teams, audiologists, clinical partners and technology team. Manage the SEO/GEO agency against agreed deliverables, timelines, reporting standards and business-linked KPIs. Share local demand insights, lead quality feedback and campaign learnings with clinic teams to improve execution and conversion. 
 4. Key Performance Indicators KPI Area: Qualified leads, digital share of total leads, lead quality by service and clinic CAC control: CAC versus approved permissible limits; cost per qualified lead, clinic visit and converted patient Conversion: Lead-to-appointment, appointment-to-visit, visit-to-assessment and assessment-to-purchase/therapy conversion Revenue & LTV: Digital-attributed revenue, repeat engagement, cross-service contribution and LTV indicators where trackable Paid media: Spend utilisation, verified conversion performance, campaign efficiency and budget reallocation discipline Organic & GEO agency : Organic qualified leads, non-branded visibility, local enquiry contribution, deliverable quality and measurable AI-search visibility Measurement: Tracking accuracy, CRM reconciliation, reporting timeliness and actionable recommendations 
 5. Required Experience & Skills Typically 5-8 years of digital marketing experience, with hands-on ownership of paid acquisition and lead-generation campaigns . Healthcare, diagnostics, hospitals, clinics, health-tech or other high-consideration services experience is strongly preferred. Strong practical expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads , including campaign setup, optimisation, testing and budget management. Comfortable analysing CAC, conversion rates, revenue and LTVnot just impressions, clicks or CPL. Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console, CRM attribution ,landing-page optimisation and reporting dashboards. Ability to brief and manage external SEO/GEO agencies, assess their work and hold them accountable to agreed outcomes. Strong analytical thinking, ownership, communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 6. Preferred Qualifications Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related field. Relevant Google Ads and analytics certifications are desirable. Experience managing multiple service lines and a multi-location clinic or service network is an advantage. 
 7. First Six-Month Outcomes Establish a reliable baseline and dashboard for paid acquisition, CAC, lead quality, funnel conversion and revenue. Build and optimise in-house paid campaigns across priority company's services and locations. Implement budget guardrails and a repeatable process to maintain CAC within approved limits. Agree an organic/GEO roadmap with the agency, with clear deliverables and reporting linked to qualified enquiries and business outcomes. Improve lead tracking and collaboration with clinic teams to reduce funnel leakage. Launch measurable patient re-engagement initiatives that support LTV and repeat engagement where clinically appropriate. Present a data-backed plan to scale digital as company's second-largest lead-generation channel while maintaining acquisition economics. 
 8. Ideal Candidate A hands-on, commercially minded digital growth professional who can independently run paid media, manage an external organic agency, interpret the full patient funnel and make sound investment decisions. The candidate should be comfortable in a growth-stage healthcare business, accountable for measurable outcomes and motivated by profitable patient acquisitionnot vanity metrics. 

 If interested share your cv at aishwarya@beanhr.com

title: S&C Global Network - AI - Song - CDP-Consultant
description:
Team :- Strategy & Consulting Global Network Practice :- Marketing Analytics Title :- Consultant/ Manager/Analyst Marketing & Customer Data Platforms (GCP, CDP, Agentic AI) Job location :- Any out of 6 AI locations WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU? As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance. What you would do in this role A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.

 Key Duties and Responsibilities:(GCP CDP) Architect & Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Build Production-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability. Model for Insight & Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics. Champion DevOps & MLOps: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build to automate testing and deployment, manage container images in Artifact Registry, and secure credentials using Google Secret Manager. Deploy & Serve: Develop and deploy containerized, serverless APIs (using Docker and Cloud Run) for real-time data ingestion and activation, feeding customer segments and triggers into marketing platforms. Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real-time inference. Collaborate & Innovate: Work within a multi-disciplinary team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, prototype new approaches, and provide expert guidance on the art of the possible with GCP and modern data engineering. Ensure Governance & Security: Implement solutions that adhere to data governance best practices and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), ensuring data is handled securely and ethically. Key Duties and Responsibilities:(RTCDP) Be a platform expert in Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Real time CDP). Developer level expertise on Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Experience Platform) is a must with other CDP platforms like Lytics, Segment, Amperity, Tealium, Treasure Data etc. including custom build CDPs as an added advantage Deep developer level expertise for real time event tracking for web analytics e.g., Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, etc. Provide deep domain expertise in our client's business and broad knowledge of digital marketing together with a Marketing Strategist industry Deep expert level knowledge of reporting tools like GA360/GA4, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics Deep expert level knowledge of paid media destinations - Google Ads, DV360, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, The Trading desk etc. Deep developer expertise for Journey Orchestration and Personalization tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer Assess and audit the current state of a client's marketing technology stack (MarTech) including data infrastructure, ad platforms and data security policies together with a solutions architect. Conduct stakeholder interviews and gather business requirements Translate business requirements into BRDs, CDP customer analytics use cases, structure technical solution Prioritize CDP use cases together with the client. Create a strategic CDP roadmap focused on data driven marketing activation. Work with the Solution Architect to strategize, architect, and document a scalable CDP/Martech implementation, tailored to the client's needs. Able to integrate multiple Martech tools. Ensure analytics are consistently implemented across digital properties. Diagnose and troubleshoot analytics/Martech implementation and platform configuration issues. Perform end-to-end QA testing for integrations. Coordinate with website developers for Analytics integration, datalayer implementation, Martech tools integration Design and Implement Adobe Stack Martech tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics Deep domain expertise in Tag Management, Journey Orchestration, Campaign Management, A/B Testing Perform technical analysis & design for Martech related initiatives. Define requirements for Martech implementation/reporting dashboard. Key Duties and Responsibilities:(Agentic AI) Architect the core interaction logic and decision-making frameworks for enterprise-grade, agentic AI systems within marketing on GCP. Leverage Google Agent Development Kit (ADKs) and APIs to orchestrate complex, multi-step agentic workflows, focusing on reasoning capabilities. Design agentic AI systems for scalability, robustness, and real-time responsiveness in autonomous marketing decision-making. Design and implement data storage strategies (Datastores) optimized for efficient retrieval of context for AI agents. Design, implement, and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to equip Gemini agents with contextually relevant information from various knowledge sources. Leverage Gemini models' reasoning capabilities to enable agents for complex analysis, strategic planning, and problem-solving in marketing contexts. Develop and apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance the reasoning, accuracy, and output quality of AI agents. Implement and leverage grounding & evaluation capabilities within Agentic AI systems to ensure outputs are factually accurate, contextually relevant, and traceable to specific data sources for marketing applications. Develop and deploy AI-driven solutions for generating multimodal marketing assets (e.g., personalized images, video snippets, audio messages) powered by Gemini. Implement LLMops best practices for the lifecycle management of agentic AI models, including CI/CD for AI components. Ensure secure and compliant interactions for AI agents, managing credentials and secrets relevant to AI model access. Implement robust monitoring, logging, and observability specifically for the performance, decision paths, and output quality of agentic AI systems. Prototype new approaches and provide expert guidance on GCP AI services, Gemini, RAG, advanced prompting, and reasoning AI techniques. Create insights presentations and client-ready decks, effectively communicating findings and recommendations. Mentor and guide junior resources, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment. Demonstrate strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively convey complex concepts and insights to stakeholders. Develop strong relationships with clients at all levels, understanding their specific challenges and opportunities. Other roles and responsibilities Business intelligence expertise for insights, actionable recommendations. Project management expertise for sprint planning Provide hands-on support and platform training for our clients. Data processing, data engineer and data schema/models expertise for CDPs to work on data models, unification logic etc. Work with Business Analysts, Data Architects, Technical Architects, DBAs to achieve project objectives - delivery dates, quality objectives etc. RTCDP (specific skills) At least 2+ years of relevant work experience of implementing CDP solutions with deep understanding of identity resolution methods with minimum 1 year in Adobe RTCDP At least 2+ years of relevant work experience in marketing, consulting, or analytics At least 2+ years of experience working in an agency environment At least 2 years of experience working as Subject matter expert in Adobe Marketing Cloud Stack Experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target is a plus. Experience with Campaign Management tools like Adobe Journey Optimizer or/and Adobe Campaign is a plus. Experience with Adobe Marketing Cloud tools like Adobe Workfront, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), DAM is a plus Experience in Postman APIs is a plus Strong hands-on with advanced JavaScript and jQuery. Able to develop custom tags/scripts using tag managers Agentic AI (specific skills) 2+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering with a data focus, or AI/ML engineering. At least 2 years of demonstrable experience building and managing data/AI solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Demonstrable experience building and deploying agentic AI systems, leveraging LLMs for complex decision-making. Hands-on experience with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and integrating external knowledge sources for LLMs. Proven ability to apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance LLM reasoning and output quality. Experience working with large language models (LLMs) with a focus on their reasoning capabilities. Hands-on experience working with Google Gemini models and their APIs/SDKs is highly preferred. Experience with multimodal AI concepts is a significant advantage. In-depth, hands-on expertise with core GCP data and AI services, including Vertex AI (for LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG pipeline development). Experience with Vertex AI RAG Engine and GCP datastore. Advanced proficiency in Python is mandatory. Familiarity with frameworks like Agent Development Kit (ADK) for building LLM applications and agentic workflows. Proficient in Terraform, CI/CD practices (Cloud Build), Docker, Artifact Registry, and Google Secret Manager. Experience in deploying and managing AI models in production environments using Vertex AI. Experience integrating with key marketing platform APIs is highly advantageous. Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer (PMLE) certification is highly desired. Exceptional problem-solving and analytical capabilities, particularly in understanding and applying reasoning to complex problems. Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive, innovative, and results-driven approach. A collaborative spirit and the capacity to mentor and guide junior team members. Technical Skills: Direct experience building or contributing to a custom Customer Data Platform (CDP) or a similar customer-centric data system. Deep GCP Expertise: Hands-on experience with key GCP data services: BigQuery, BigTable, Vertex AI, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Composer (Airflow), Cloud Functions, Cloud schedular and GKE. MLOps Experience: Familiarity with deploying and managing models using Vertex AI (or similar platforms like SageMaker/MLflow) is a strong advantage. Modern Data Stack Knowledge: Experience with tools like dbt (Data Build Tool) for data transformation is a significant plus. Security Best Practices: Experience using tools like Google Secret Manager or HashiCorp Vault to manage application secrets. Accuracy and timely submission of monthly MIS reports. Proper maintenance of financial documents and audit records. Compliance with internal financial procedures. 7. Personal Attributes Strong analytical and numerical skills. Good communication and coordination abilities. Attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to meet deadlines and work independently. description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 ACCOUNTS EXECUTIVE 
 Company: Hospedia Medicare Pvt. Ltd.
 Department: Accounts & Finance
 Location: Plot No. 204, Udyog Vihar, Industrial Area, Phase VI, Sector 37, Gurugram, Haryana 122001
 Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

 Reporting To: Designated Accounts Supervisor / Management, as per the company's reporting structure 
 1. Job Purpose Hospedia Medicare is looking for a detail-oriented and organised Accounts Executive to manage assigned accounting operations and contribute to the smooth functioning of the company's Accounts & Finance department. The role involves handling routine accounting activities, including purchase and expense invoice entries, bill verification, accounting documentation, reconciliations, GST-related data preparation and accounting reports using Zoho Books and Tally Prime . The Accounts Executive will work alongside the existing accountant, with clearly defined responsibilities to ensure accurate financial records, timely processing of transactions and efficient management of the department's workload. The ideal candidate should have practical knowledge of accounting software, a good understanding of GST and MS Excel, and the ability to manage assigned responsibilities independently while escalating discrepancies and matters requiring review or approval. 
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Purchase and Expense Accounting Record purchase invoices, expense bills and other financial transactions accurately in Zoho Books and/or Tally Prime, as applicable to the company's accounting workflow. Verify supplier details, invoice numbers, dates, GSTIN, taxable values, GST amounts and total invoice values before recording transactions. Check for duplicate invoices, missing information, calculation errors and discrepancies. Upload, scan and organise bills and supporting documents in the designated digital folders or accounting system. Maintain accurate records of purchase invoices, expense bills and supporting documentation. Coordinate with purchase, stores and administrative teams to obtain missing bills and supporting documents. 
 B. Routine Accounting Operations Handle assigned purchase, sales, expense and bank entries in the relevant accounting system. Maintain vendor records, ledgers and other assigned accounting schedules. Update Excel trackers for bills received, bills entered, pending documents and other accounting activities. Ensure accounting records are complete, accurate and up to date. Follow established accounting procedures and ensure transactions are supported by appropriate documentation. Identify and report unusual transactions or discrepancies requiring clarification. 
 C. Zoho Books and Accounting System Management Use Zoho Books for assigned accounting entries, vendor and transaction records, document management and routine financial reporting. Maintain accurate and consistent accounting information in the designated system. Assist in checking transaction details, supporting documents and relevant ledger information. Coordinate with the accountant to resolve discrepancies and maintain the integrity of accounting records. Follow the company's established workflow for using Zoho Books and Tally Prime, avoiding duplicate entries and inconsistencies between systems. 
 D. Bank and Vendor Reconciliations Prepare bank reconciliation statements and vendor account reconciliations. Identify differences between ledger balances, bank statements, invoices and supporting records. Follow up on outstanding entries, missing invoices, credit notes and other unresolved differences. Maintain reconciliation records and submit them for review within agreed timelines. 
 E. GST and Compliance Support Verify basic GST details on purchase and sales invoices. Prepare purchase and sales data and supporting documents for GST reconciliation and return preparation. Assist in checking input tax credit documentation and identifying discrepancies for review. Coordinate with the accountant or authorised professional to resolve GST-related differences. Maintain organised records for statutory compliance and audit requirements. 
 F. Reporting and Month-End Support Prepare routine accounting reports, pending-bill statements and reconciliation schedules. Assist with month-end accounting activities and supporting schedules. Maintain records of pending documents and unresolved accounting differences. Provide accounting data and supporting documents for management review. Support internal and external audits by organising invoices, vouchers, ledgers and relevant records. 
 G. Coordination and Responsibility Coordinate with internal departments and vendors to resolve documentation-related queries. Take ownership of assigned accounting activities and complete them within stipulated timelines. Keep the designated reporting person informed about pending work and issues requiring decisions. Maintain confidentiality of financial information and adhere to company policies and accounting procedures. Perform other relevant accounting responsibilities assigned by management. 
 3. Skills and Competencies Practical working knowledge of Zoho Books and Tally Prime. Good understanding of purchase accounting, expense entries and routine accounting transactions. Basic to intermediate understanding of GST invoices, GSTIN verification and GST concepts. Working knowledge of MS Excel, including formulas, sorting, filters and basic reporting. Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy. Ability to identify discrepancies and follow up until resolution. Good organisational skills and systematic record management. Ability to manage assigned accounting activities independently after initial training. Good communication and coordination skills. Integrity, reliability and commitment to maintaining accurate financial records. 
 4. Qualifications and Experience B.Com or another relevant commerce, accounting or finance qualification preferred. 1–2 years of relevant experience in accounting operations preferred. Candidates with 6 months to 1 year of practical experience may also be considered if they demonstrate strong accounting fundamentals and working knowledge of the required software. Experience in a manufacturing, trading or SME environment will be an advantage. 
 5. Working Relationship and Responsibility The Accounts Executive will work alongside the existing accountant, with clearly allocated responsibilities for routine accounting operations. The position requires independent ownership of assigned activities rather than only data-entry or administrative support. The existing accountant and management will retain the applicable review, approval and statutory responsibilities under the company's established processes. The candidate will be expected to work collaboratively, maintain accurate records and contribute to improving the efficiency and timeliness of accounting operations. 
 6. Candidate Profile We are looking for a dependable, systematic and detail-oriented professional who can take ownership of routine accounting work, maintain accurate records and manage assigned responsibilities with minimal supervision after training. The candidate should be comfortable working with invoices, numerical data, accounting software and supporting documents, and should demonstrate the ability to identify errors rather than simply enter information without verification.

title: Senior Manager - UK Accounts and Tax
description:
Location: Pune, India (Sinhgad Road, Work From Office, 12:00 pm to 9:00 pm shift) Position: Full-time, Permanent, Senior Management Reporting to: Partner, UK Services Team led: 10–15 accountants, tax and payroll executives, through their own team leads Experience: 15+ years in accounting, including 8+ years on UK accounts and tax Clients: UK accountancy practices, owner-managed companies, sole traders, landlords and individuals Peak season: 31 January Self Assessment deadline The Role SDC is a Pune-based chartered accountancy firm that delivers accounting, tax and payroll work for clients in the United Kingdom. Our UK desk is growing, and we are looking for a highly experienced, commercially minded senior professional to lead it end to end. You will be the person UK clients call when something matters. You will sign off the work, set the standard for quality, and build a team that can handle thousands of returns and year-end files without missing a deadline. This is a hands-on, fee-generating leadership role, not simply a supervisory position. We want someone who can review a complex Self Assessment with foreign income in the morning, settle a client escalation at lunch, and coach a new team lead in the afternoon, while contributing directly to the profitability of the UK desk and developing a capable, accountable and increasingly independent team. Why now: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax went live in April 2026, FRS 102 has changed for leases and revenue, and the non-dom rules have been replaced. UK clients need offshore partners who understand all of it. You will make sure SDC is that partner. Key Responsibilities 
1. Client & Portfolio Leadership Act as the senior point of contact for UK partner firms and direct clients. Own turnaround times, SLAs and the escalation route; identify and resolve complex technical issues and escalate appropriately. Run regular client reviews, act on feedback and spot scope for additional work with the UK business development team. 2. UK Accounts & Reporting Oversee year-end accounts for limited companies, LLPs, partnerships and sole traders under FRS 102 (including Section 1A) and FRS 105. Review bookkeeping, reconciliations, management accounts and MIS. Make sure Companies House filings are accurate and on time. 
3. UK Tax Compliance Review and sign off Self Assessment (SA100 and supplementary pages), partnership (SA800) and corporation tax (CT600) returns. Handle residence, split-year treatment, the foreign income and gains (FIG) regime, double tax relief and foreign tax credits. Advise clients on the reliefs and allowances open to them. 
4. Payroll & VAT Oversee RTI payroll (FPS/EPS), P11Ds, pension auto-enrolment and payroll year-end. Review VAT returns filed under Making Tax Digital for VAT. Keep yearly rate and threshold updates current in our systems. 5. Fee Generation & Commercial Management Personally undertake chargeable assignments and generate fees alongside leading the team. Make sure the team delivers work efficiently and profitably. Prepare and raise invoices within agreed authority, monitor work in progress and ensure timely billing. Monitor budgets, fee recovery, productivity and assignment profitability. Identify additional chargeable work and opportunities to increase fee income. 
6. Team Leadership & Development Lead, coach and review a team of 10–15, through their own team leads. Set KRAs, run quarterly performance reviews and yearly appraisals. Hire and train, and build the next layer of reviewers and team leads. 
7. Process, Quality, Technology & Reporting Own SOPs, checklists and a multi-level review process. Keep client data secure and GDPR-compliant. Identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and stronger internal controls. Plan capacity for the January peak and report monthly MIS to the partners. 
 UK Changes You Will Lead Us Through Familiarity with all four is expected. 
 6 April 2025 – Non-dom rules replaced. The remittance basis has gone. New UK residents are taxed under a residence-based regime, with a four-year exemption for foreign income and gains (FIG) for those who qualify. November 2025 – Companies House identity checks. Directors and people with significant control must verify their identity, and agents filing for clients must be authorised (ACSP). 1 January 2026 – FRS 102 periodic review. For periods beginning on or after this date, most leases come on to the balance sheet and revenue follows a five-step model. 6 April 2026 – Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. Sole traders and landlords with qualifying income over £50,000 now send quarterly digital updates. The threshold drops to £30,000 in April 2027 and £20,000 in April 2028. 
What You Bring Essential 
 15+ years in accounting, with at least 8 years delivering UK accounts, tax and payroll for UK clients from India (outsourcing, KPO or captive centre). 5+ years managing a team of 8 or more, including review sign-off and appraisals. Hands-on depth in UK Self Assessment (including residence and foreign income), CT600 and FRS 102/105 year-end accounts. A record of running a peak season at volume, for example thousands of Self Assessment returns to the 31 January deadline. A track record of personal fee-earning, billing discipline and improving profitability.  Confident, clear English on calls and in writing with UK partners and clients.  Advanced Excel and strong MIS reporting.  CA, ACCA or CMA, or an M.Com / MBA (Finance) backed by equivalent UK experience. 
A Strong Plus ATT or CTA (completed or in progress), or AAT. Experience moving clients on to MTD for Income Tax. UK payroll depth: RTI, auto-enrolment, P11D. Setting up a new UK process or taking over work from a UK firm. ISO 9001 / ISO 27001 internal audit or process-improvement work. Automation of review or reporting steps. 
 UK software : working knowledge of several of Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, IRIS, CCH, TaxCalc, Taxfiler, BTC Software, Dext and Hubdoc.
 
 How Success Will be Measured 
Technical quality, timely delivery, personal and team fee production, billing efficiency, staff development and measurable operational improvements.
 
 Your First 90 Days First 30 days – Learn. Meet the UK clients and the team. Learn our SOPs, and review the live portfolio and deadline calendar. By day 60 – Own. Take over final review sign-off and client escalations. Set KRAs for every team member. By day 90 – Shape. Present an MTD (Making Tax Digital) readiness and process plan to the partners, along with your first monthly MIS pack. 
 What We Offer 
 Pay that matches the role: Set by the depth of your UK experience. A seat near the decisions: You work directly with the partners and have a real say in how the UK desk grows. Build, not just run: Room to shape processes, tools and team structure as the practice scales. Varied UK work: Companies, partnerships, landlords and internationally mobile individuals, so no two weeks are the same.

Analyse: ROAS ACOS TACOS CTR CPC Conversion Rate Impressions Clicks Ad Sales Ad Spend Organic Sales Total Sales Compare advertising performance against sales and profitability targets. Ability to independently manage advertising budgets. Strong attention to detail and numerical skills. Performance-oriented mindset with a focus on sales and ROI . 
 Preferred Experience 25 years of experience in Amazon PPC / Amazon Ads. Experience managing multiple brands and large advertising budgets. Our Pillars: Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans. Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions. Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting. AXA Hearts in Action : We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving. For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

title: Associate, Finance and Operations
description:
Job Title: Associate, Finance and Operations 
 Location: Pune, India 
About the Company
First Insight is a healthcare technology company headquartered in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, USA. With more than 30 years of innovation and industry leadership, First Insight serves over 2,000 eye care professionals nationwide through an integrated technology platform.
In 1994, First Insight became the first company to introduce a fully integrated EHR, Practice Management, and Optical Management solution specifically designed for optometrists and ophthalmologists. Today, our global team operates across the United States and India. Our product ecosystem includes:
 MaximEyes EHR, Practice Management, and Optical Software Fast Pay Health Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Billing Services EVAA AI-powered workflow automation and intelligence platform 
 We are committed to improving patient outcomes, increasing practice efficiency, and driving financial performance for healthcare providers through innovative technology and exceptional service. To learn more, visit www.first-insight.com. 
 Role Summary
 The Associate, Finance and Operations will work closely with the Vice President - Finance & Operations, providing analytical, reporting, coordination and follow-up support across finance, SaaS performance, sales, pricing, operations, HR, IT and governance. The role requires strong ownership of data, disciplined follow-through, sound judgement, attention to detail and the ability to identify exceptions and raise timely alerts. The position is broader than traditional executive assistance and is focused on helping leadership monitor business performance and drive closure of key actions. 
 Key Responsibilities 
1. Budgeting, Financial Planning and Cash Management Assist in preparing annual budgets, forecasts and periodic budget revisions in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Track monthly actuals against budget, analyse variances, identify key drivers and flag material deviations for review. Monitor daily cash flows against budget and forecast, maintain cash-flow trackers and highlight actual or anticipated shortfalls and unusual movements. Monitor banking-system notifications and alerts relating to payments, receipts, balances and other relevant transactions; escalate exceptions promptly. Maintain a finance calendar covering reporting deadlines, month-end activities, budget cycles and relevant statutory or tax due dates. 
 2. SaaS Metrics, Analytics and Management Dashboards Track key SaaS metrics on a regular basis and analyse their movement, business implications and impact on financial and operating performance. Coordinate with key stakeholders to obtain accurate, complete and timely data, explanations and supporting reports. Consolidate, validate and organise SaaS metrics and analytics into a consistent reporting framework. Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly dashboards covering agreed financial, commercial and operational KPIs. Highlight trends, variances, risks, missing data and exceptions, and follow up with metric owners for explanations and corrective actions. 
 3. Accounts Receivable / Accounts Payable (AR/AP) Coordination Maintain regular contact with AR/AP staff to understand and resolve operational queries and blockers. Visit the AR/AP desk daily to review pending queries, coordinate responses and help drive timely resolution. Track recurring issues, ageing items and unresolved queries; escalate matters that require management intervention. Coordinate with finance, billing and collections stakeholders to obtain status updates and support timely decisions. 
 4. Sales Reporting, Pricing and Incentives Analyse sales reports and prepare weekly sales summaries for inclusion in the overall management dashboard. Track sales targets, pipeline, bookings, closures and other agreed performance indicators. Assist with product pricing analysis, pricing scenarios, pricing directives, discount structures and related commercial assessments. Maintain and track sales-staff incentive calculations and reports, and flag discrepancies or items requiring review or approval. Coordinate with sales and other relevant stakeholders to obtain clarifications and ensure reporting consistency. 
 5. Operations, R&D, Technical Support, Training and Fast Pay Health Reporting Collect and consolidate operating reports from the Fast Pay Health team and incorporate relevant metrics and updates into the weekly/monthly dashboard. Obtain relevant reports from the R&D team, track agreed deliverables and include key updates, risks and dependencies in the weekly/monthly dashboard. Collect and track technical support reports, including training and service performance, outstanding issues and relevant updates, and incorporate them into the weekly/monthly dashboard. Follow up with report owners on delays, unusual trends, unresolved issues and actions due; escalate material concerns to the VP or relevant functional head. 
 6. HR Coordination and People Reporting Coordinate with HR on open positions, hiring progress, interview status and pending decisions. Follow up on finalisation and updating of job descriptions and other recruitment-related deliverables. Obtain regular HR reports and consolidate agreed people metrics into the weekly/monthly dashboard. Include relevant employee-survey results and follow-up actions in management reporting, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality. 
 7. IT Reporting and Cost Consciousness Obtain regular reports from IT and incorporate relevant updates, metrics, risks and deliverables into the monthly dashboard. Promote cost consciousness and identify opportunities to reduce both human-resource and non-human-resource costs without compromising essential business requirements or service quality. Track agreed cost-saving initiatives, owners, milestones and outcomes, and report progress to the VP. Coordinate with IT, administration and facilities on relevant operational requirements, vendor matters and renewals. 
 8. Agreements, Renewals, Company Secretarial and Audit Support Review and vet business agreements for completeness, consistency with approved commercial terms and potential business or financial risks; this is an initial review and not a substitute for formal legal advice. Identify and raise red flags, unusual clauses, commercial deviations, missing approvals, liabilities or other issues requiring review by the VP, legal counsel or other authorised stakeholders. Maintain an organised tracker of contracts, business agreements, renewals, notice periods, key obligations and approval status. Provide timely alerts for upcoming renewals, deadlines, commitments and agreements requiring action. Maintain confidential and orderly records of contracts, due-diligence materials and other sensitive documentation. Work with the Company Secretary and external audit firm on routine annual activities and non-routine assignments, including secretarial and compliance-related matters. Coordinate the collection of information, schedules, confirmations and supporting documents required for audits, filings, reviews and other governance activities. Maintain trackers for requests, deliverables, due dates and open points, and follow up with relevant stakeholders until completion. Handle financial, employee, customer, investor, contractual and other confidential information with discretion. 
 9. Customer Escalations and Operations Follow-through Maintain an up-to-date register of escalated customers, including issue summary, owner, ageing, next action, target resolution date and current status. Include customer escalations and material changes in the weekly/monthly dashboard, raise flags where required and keep the status current. Assist the VP in reviewing escalations, questioning relevant stakeholders, obtaining root-cause updates and driving resolution. Track follow-up meetings, commitments and deliverables for the VP and other designated leaders, and pursue action owners until closure. Escalate overdue actions, repeated service issues and risks to customer retention or satisfaction. 
 10. Venture Capital Fund / Elevate Management Support Assist in preparing annual budgets, forecasts and periodic budget revisions in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Track the amount available for investment across funds and reconcile reported balances with relevant finance records and stakeholder updates. Review weekly/monthly dashboards for completeness, consistency and accuracy; flag errors, unusual movements, missing information and material exceptions promptly. 
 11. Executive Support, Meetings and Ad Hoc Assignments Maintain action trackers for the VP and relevant operations meetings; record decisions, owners and due dates, and follow up until closure. Prepare meeting materials, summaries, dashboards and presentations for internal reviews and leadership discussions. Coordinate with the CEOs office, US leadership and cross-functional stakeholders on agreed priorities, deadlines and deliverables. Undertake ad hoc analyses, reports, research and special assignments as directed by the VP. Maintain clear, accurate and professional written communication and handle sensitive matters appropriately. 
 Qualifications and Experience 
Must Have MBA in Finance from a premier institution in India. Experience in finance, business operations, management reporting, analytics or executive support; experience in IT/SaaS or a US-facing business is an advantage. Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, data consolidation and dashboard preparation; proficiency in PowerPoint, Word and/or Google Workspace. Working understanding of budgets, cash flow, invoices, AR/AP, financial reports and business KPIs. Excellent written and spoken English, strong organisation and follow-up skills, and high attention to detail. Ability to work with confidential information and communicate professionally with stakeholders at different levels. Extensive experience using AI to prepare sales dashboards, operating metrics, management reports and sales performance reports. Extensive experience harnessing AI for problem-solving, analysis, identifying trends and improving reporting efficiency. 
Good to Have Familiarity with accounting and CRM systems, particularly QuickBooks and HubSpot. Exposure to contract tracking, audit coordination, company secretarial work or US-based leadership teams. 
 Key Attributes Analytical, methodical and comfortable working with numbers and multiple data sources. Proactive in identifying gaps, inconsistencies, risks and opportunities for improvement. Persistent and tactful in following up with stakeholders and driving closure. Dependable, discreet and calm under pressure, with the ability to manage shifting priorities. Cost-conscious, collaborative and committed to accurate, timely reporting. 
 Working Hours and Location 
The role is based at First Insight - Pune office in India. Working hours are 1:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. IST. The position will generally follow these agreed core office hours, with flexibility for occasional evening or late-night coordination with US stakeholders, month-end reporting, leadership reviews or urgent business requirements. Any extended hours will be based on business needs and agreed expectations. 
What We Offer
Direct exposure to finance and operations leadership in a US healthcare SaaS business. Cross-functional experience across finance, SaaS analytics, sales, pricing, operations, HR, IT and governance. An opportunity to contribute to management reporting, business performance and continuous improvement. A collaborative team environment in Pune.

description:
About the Team: Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK s internal operations in Digital Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise. Enterprise Systems Management Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organization. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigor and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward. Job Purpose: GSK s Global Supply Chain DT team is the front facing business tech group supporting GSK s critical business of Global Manufacturing across all product portfolios. The team comprises of multiple business tech disciplines from site specific DT partnering through to above site and global services like Data Analytics and Global Demand Supply Planning processes. The Team consists of a set of portfolio and business operations manager aligned to GSC DT Towers and VPs. The team is responsible for defining as well as ensuring portfolio delivery processes, standards, reporting and governance are adhered to and understood by product owners and VPs across GSC DT. The team is also responsible for the PMO delivery toolset and its maintenance. In addition the team is accountable for business operations for each of the towers, in ensuring all Finance, HC and Contracts are clearly understood and driven with the respective GSC DT LT members, VPs. The Senior Principal - Business Operations Manager role is a key position for to setup and execute standards and processes on business operations for each of the GSC DT Towers, to ensure all Finance, HC and Contracts are clearly understood and controlled. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Deploy and run a robust financial management service in close collaboration with the GSC DT Finance Business Partner for the specific function. Keep the Towers financial, headcount and contract plan integrated with the delivery plan, and manage the dependencies, risks and decisions that affect budget and supplier commitments. Define and execute clear processes for capturing, reviewing and allocating financial requirements across GSC DT LT members and their portfolios. Lead monthly management of the GSC DT financial summary and tower-level views across employment costs (FTE and non-FTE), contracts, depreciation, training and TE. Own the discretionary budget allocation process and support the decisions across the Tower using data-driven insights on Capex/Opex, benefits, risks and impacts. Ensure every funded item has a baseline, a named benefit owner and a measurement schedule, and track benefits beyond closure. Deploy and run a proactive vendor and contract management service for the GSC DT function, with clear structure and stakeholder accountabilities. Manage vendor risk, keep contract records audit-ready, and apply supplier controls proportionate to GxP requirements. Establish a unified vendor and contract management approach that can be applied consistently across all parts of GSC DT. Coach Product Directors, Product Owners and Tower teams on budget ownership and contract discipline and raise the maturity of the business-operations method across towers. Design, improve and operate governance systems and processes, working with senior business stakeholders to provide independent, consistent governance across GSC DT. Ensure finance and contract decisions use the same demand route and prioritisation criteria as portfolio management, and that every funded item links to strategy and OKRs. Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in Finance, Business, Technology, Computer Science, or a relevant discipline. Minimum 10 years of job-related experience in a technology or digital environment. Experience managing Capex and Opex budgets valued in the millions of pounds or equivalent currency. Experience managing financial planning, budget allocation and cross-charging models. Experience managing vendors and commercial contracts. Experience managing supplier commitments, vendor risks, contract records and contract governance processes. Experience establishing and operating business operations, financial management or governance processes. Experience working with Director, VP or equivalent leadership-level stakeholders on financial, vendor, contract, workforce or business-operations decisions. Experience managing delivery against defined budget, timeline and quality requirements. Experience using Microsoft Excel for financial/budget analysis and Microsoft PowerPoint for management reporting and presentations. Availability for business travel as required. Preferred Qualifications Master s degree with a specialization in Finance, or a professional finance/accounting qualification such as CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent. Finance/accounting qualification, such as CIMA, ACCA or equivalent. PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or equivalent project/programme management certification. Qualification/certification related to portfolio management or governance. Qualification/certification related to procurement or vendor management. description:
Role Overview 
 What is the purpose of this role- what are they there to achieve? 
The Factory Primary Logistics Specialist Region (IBH) is responsible for the regional execution, coordination, and escalation of primary logistics flows involving factories, ensuring raw materials, semi-finished and finished goods move reliably across the internal supply and distribution network.
Operating from the IBH delivery hub, the role executes and coordinates factoryrelated primary logistics activities across multiple sites, acting as the central execution point for factorytofactory and factorytodistributioncentre flows within the region. The role ensures primary logistics movements are visible, progressing as planned, and issues are identified and escalated early to protect downstream distribution and market supply.
 Key Responsibilities 
 What are the primary activities that this role will be accountable for? 
 Execute and coordinate regional factoryrelated primary logistics flows, including factorytofactory and factorytodistributioncentre movements.
 Control daytoday factoryfacing primary logistics execution, including shipment sequencing, dispatch readiness alignment, and exception handling across sites.
¢ Track primary logistics movements (milestones, ETAs, delivery status) and proactively identify and manage delays, risks, shortages, or dispatch/receipt issues impacting network supply.
¢ Coordinate scheduling and handovers between factories and distribution centres, ensuring dispatch and receipt readiness is aligned, including delivery windows or slots where applicable.
¢ Support rapid resolution of primary logistics execution issues by executing recovery actions and escalating where execution thresholds are exceeded.
¢ Maintain accurate execution updates and inputs for regional primary logistics performance reporting.
 What are the core decisions that this role will be accountable for? 
¢ Execution decisions related to factorylevel primary logistics coordination across the region.
¢ Selection of appropriate execution actions to resolve primary logistics delivery or handover issues within defined priorities.
¢ Escalation of factoryrelated primary logistics risks or constraints to the Primary Logistics Lead Region (IBH).

 We are seeking an experienced Employee Transport Manager to oversee and manage the day-to-day operations of employee commute/shuttle services, ensuring safe, timely, and cost-effective transportation for staff. This role requires hands-on experience specifically in employee/staff transportation management candidates from a cargo, freight, or supply chain logistics background will not be considered eligible for this role, as the skill set and operational focus differ significantly from passenger transport management.

Liaise with HR and Admin teams for new hire onboarding to transport facility, shift changes, and policy updates. Candidates with primary experience in cargo, freight, courier, or supply chain logistics management are not eligible for this role. Strong knowledge of local transport regulations, route planning tools, and GPS/fleet tracking systems. Experience managing third-party transport vendors/contractors and SLAs. Proficiency in MS Excel and transport management software/applications. 
 Preferred Skills Strong communication and vendor negotiation skills. Crisis management and problem-solving ability, especially for real-time operational issues. Experience handling large-scale employee transport (500+ employees/day) is a plus. Familiarity with women's safety protocols and compliance (e.g., night shift transport guidelines) is an advantage.

title: Senior Manager - UK Accounts and Tax
description:
Location: Pune, India (Sinhgad Road, Work From Office, 12:00 pm to 9:00 pm shift) Position: Full-time, Permanent, Senior Management Reporting to: Partner, UK Services Team led: 10–15 accountants, tax and payroll executives, through their own team leads Experience: 15+ years in accounting, including 8+ years on UK accounts and tax Clients: UK accountancy practices, owner-managed companies, sole traders, landlords and individuals Peak season: 31 January Self Assessment deadline The Role SDC is a Pune-based chartered accountancy firm that delivers accounting, tax and payroll work for clients in the United Kingdom. Our UK desk is growing, and we are looking for a highly experienced, commercially minded senior professional to lead it end to end. You will be the person UK clients call when something matters. You will sign off the work, set the standard for quality, and build a team that can handle thousands of returns and year-end files without missing a deadline. This is a hands-on, fee-generating leadership role, not simply a supervisory position. We want someone who can review a complex Self Assessment with foreign income in the morning, settle a client escalation at lunch, and coach a new team lead in the afternoon, while contributing directly to the profitability of the UK desk and developing a capable, accountable and increasingly independent team. Why now: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax went live in April 2026, FRS 102 has changed for leases and revenue, and the non-dom rules have been replaced. UK clients need offshore partners who understand all of it. You will make sure SDC is that partner. Key Responsibilities 
1. Client & Portfolio Leadership Act as the senior point of contact for UK partner firms and direct clients. Own turnaround times, SLAs and the escalation route; identify and resolve complex technical issues and escalate appropriately. Run regular client reviews, act on feedback and spot scope for additional work with the UK business development team. 2. UK Accounts & Reporting Oversee year-end accounts for limited companies, LLPs, partnerships and sole traders under FRS 102 (including Section 1A) and FRS 105. Review bookkeeping, reconciliations, management accounts and MIS. Make sure Companies House filings are accurate and on time. 
3. UK Tax Compliance Review and sign off Self Assessment (SA100 and supplementary pages), partnership (SA800) and corporation tax (CT600) returns. Handle residence, split-year treatment, the foreign income and gains (FIG) regime, double tax relief and foreign tax credits. Advise clients on the reliefs and allowances open to them. 
4. Payroll & VAT Oversee RTI payroll (FPS/EPS), P11Ds, pension auto-enrolment and payroll year-end. Review VAT returns filed under Making Tax Digital for VAT. Keep yearly rate and threshold updates current in our systems. 5. Fee Generation & Commercial Management Personally undertake chargeable assignments and generate fees alongside leading the team. Make sure the team delivers work efficiently and profitably. Prepare and raise invoices within agreed authority, monitor work in progress and ensure timely billing. Monitor budgets, fee recovery, productivity and assignment profitability. Identify additional chargeable work and opportunities to increase fee income. 
6. Team Leadership & Development Lead, coach and review a team of 10–15, through their own team leads. Set KRAs, run quarterly performance reviews and yearly appraisals. Hire and train, and build the next layer of reviewers and team leads. 
7. Process, Quality, Technology & Reporting Own SOPs, checklists and a multi-level review process. Keep client data secure and GDPR-compliant. Identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and stronger internal controls. Plan capacity for the January peak and report monthly MIS to the partners. 
 UK Changes You Will Lead Us Through Familiarity with all four is expected. 
 6 April 2025 – Non-dom rules replaced. The remittance basis has gone. New UK residents are taxed under a residence-based regime, with a four-year exemption for foreign income and gains (FIG) for those who qualify. November 2025 – Companies House identity checks. Directors and people with significant control must verify their identity, and agents filing for clients must be authorised (ACSP). 1 January 2026 – FRS 102 periodic review. For periods beginning on or after this date, most leases come on to the balance sheet and revenue follows a five-step model. 6 April 2026 – Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. Sole traders and landlords with qualifying income over £50,000 now send quarterly digital updates. The threshold drops to £30,000 in April 2027 and £20,000 in April 2028. 
What You Bring Essential 
 15+ years in accounting, with at least 8 years delivering UK accounts, tax and payroll for UK clients from India (outsourcing, KPO or captive centre). 5+ years managing a team of 8 or more, including review sign-off and appraisals. Hands-on depth in UK Self Assessment (including residence and foreign income), CT600 and FRS 102/105 year-end accounts. title: Sr Manager - Business Partnering & Digital Solution
description:
Job Title: Senior Manager - Business Partnering & Digital Solution Grade: E Department: Finance, IT and Legal Reporting to: Director - Finance, IT and Legal Location: New Delhi (National Support Office), with travel to state offices Contract duration: 5 years (extendable) 
 About Bal Raksha Bharat Bal Raksha Bharat (also known as Save the Children) is Indias leading independent child rights organisation. It is a member of Save the Children movement that operates globally with the mission to inspire breakthroughs in the way the world treats children and achieve immediate and lasting changes in their lives. We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030: - No child dies from preventable causes before their fifth birthday - All children learn from a quality basic education - Violence against children is no longer tolerated We implement programmes in the remotest corners of India and urban areas in the areas of Health & Nutrition, Education, Child Protection and Livelihood & Economic Wellbeing in order to facilitate quality education, healthcare and protection from harm and abuse and life-saving aid during emergencies to children. ROLE PURPOSE The Senior Manager - Business Partnering & Digital Solution will act as a trusted business partner to all functional heads and work closely with the Director, Finance, IT & Legal to build Bal Raksha Bharats business functional needs into working and compliant digital solutions. The role owns the complete business applications portfolio, including Microsoft Dynamics Business Central and the entire organisational data, re-engineers the processes before automating them, manages external solution vendors, leads data compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDPA) and DPDP Rules 2025, and governs the responsible use of AI across the organisation. This role coordinates with the infrastructure team on IT security and backup. Functional solutions and business partnering - Act as the dedicated digital business partner and a single point of contact for all functional heads, understanding their strategy on technology needs. - Participate in annual planning and quarterly reviews with functional heads to agree a joint digital plan tied to strategy and goals. - Participate in discussions with department heads and their team to shape user needs, challenge requests, propose better process and technology options and frame each initiative with expected benefits, costs and risk. Work with functional teams to build business requirement documents with key metrics, user stories and acceptance criteria. - Own the business application portfolio (Donor 360/BRISK, Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, HRMS (GreytHR), SCMS, and all other solutions platforms and collaboration suite), including future technology roadmaps, all licenses and user adoption. - Lead user acceptance testing with functional users, training and change management for every release. - Track benefits post go-live (time saved, data quality, compliance, user satisfaction) and report value delivered back to function heads. - Run surveys and service reviews for regular user feedbacks and act accordingly. Process engineering and automation - Map current-state processes, identify process waste and control gaps, and design to-be processes before any build. - Identify automation processes with a simple business case: hours saved, errors reduced, risk reduced. - Embed privacy-by-design and child data safeguarding checks in every redesigned process. Vendor and solution delivery management - Draft RFPs in consultation with the Procurement team and scope of work, run evaluations, and negotiate contracts with implementation partners and SaaS providers in line with procurement policy. - Ensure contracts carry DPDPA-compliant data processing terms, security obligations, breach notification duties, data return/deletion and AI-specific clauses - Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and within budget; track SLAs and run monthly vendor reviews. - Keep internal ownership of solution designs, configurations, documentation and credentials so no vendor holds lock-in. Data, BI and integration - Identify opportunities to integrate data across all applications into a data warehouse or equivalent repository, and execute an integrated data and BI roadmap, aligned with transformation objectives ensuring accuracy and integrity so the organisation has one source of data truth. - Oversee the development of BI reports, dashboards and visualisations and create opportunities for users to use Power BI. - Use SQL and analysis to validate data, interpret trends and patterns, and quality-check vendor outputs. - Ensure database security, performance and reliability, and maintain backup, recovery and disaster recovery plans for business applications. DPDPA and data protection programme - Lead the DPDPA compliance plan: identify personal data inventory, purpose and retention mapping, lawful basis and consent records and implement and automate notice and consent flows, including verifiable parental/guardian consent - Own the breach response with key stakeholders, for notification to the Data Protection Board and affected individuals. - Run data protection impact assessments for any new systems, vendors and AI use cases. - Deliver organisation-wide privacy awareness training, with role-specific modules for field staff handling child data. AI governance and adoption - Maintain an AI use register and approve AI use cases through a risk-tiered review covering privacy, child safeguarding, bias, accuracy and human oversight. - Take priority AI pilots from idea to measured outcome - Build staff AI literacy through practical sessions and a champions network. Governance, budget and stakeholder communication - Manage and support financial planning and budgeting for technology investments. - Report monthly on delivery, risk and compliance status to the CFO, and quarterly to the leadership team/board committee. - Communicate effectively with stakeholders to ensure alignment and understanding of digital initiatives. BEHAVIOURS (Values in Practice) Accountability - Holds self and others accountable for delivering high-quality, timely and compliant services aligned with organisational goals. - Demonstrates ownership and responsibility for procurement decisions, resources and commitments with integrity. Ambition - Sets ambitious goals for efficiency, value for money, service quality and operational excellence. - Seeks opportunities to simplify, innovate and build a high-performing procurement and facilities function. Collaboration - Builds strong relationships across functions, state teams and external stakeholders. - Encourages mutual respect, transparency, knowledge sharing and customer-focused service. Creativity - Brings innovative and practical solutions to sourcing, facilities, technology and cost optimisation challenges. - Champions new approaches that improve efficiency, sustainability and user experience. Integrity - Upholds the highest ethical standards, transparency and fairness in procurement and vendor dealings. Promotes responsible stewardship of organisational resources and puts childrens best interests at the centre of decisions. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. An MBA or Masters degree is a plus. Privacy certification (CIPP/A, CIPM, DCPP) is desirable and not must. EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS Minimum 8-10 years in technology, with at least 5 years in a techno-functional role (business analysis, application management or solution delivery). Hands-on delivery of at least two enterprise implementations end to end (CRM, ERP, HRMS or case management) with vendor management accountability. Experience in an NGO, CSR or donor-funded organisation is preferred. KEY COMPETENCIES Strong business partnering mindset to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, negotiate priorities and links technology decisions to outcomes. Effective communication and interpersonal skills; able to translate into plain language. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with sound judgement on data and AI risk. Understanding of child safeguarding principles Excellent project management and organisational abilities. Experience procuring and contract-managing SaaS and implementation vendors. Working knowledge of the DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025, with practical experience implementing privacy controls (consent, data mapping, breach response).
