title: Senior Erp Manager
description:
Senior ERP Manager Microsoft Dynamics ERP | Business Central / NAV Location: Kuwait or Saudi Arabia
 Employment: Full-time, on-site
 Employer: Confidential regional e-commerce business
 Applications welcome from India and other markets. Relocation is required for candidates based outside the designated work location. 
 Lead the ERP function behind a high-volume GCC e-commerce business We are seeking an experienced ERP leader to take ownership of the platform, team and integrations supporting a complex regional business. This is an opportunity to shape the ERP roadmap, influence technical decisions, develop internal capability and deliver improvements across Finance, Procurement, Inventory and business operations. Our environment is Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Dynamics 365 Business Central. Direct experience with these platforms is strongly preferred. We also welcome accomplished leaders from Dynamics 365 Finance, Supply Chain Management, Finance & Operations or Dynamics AX backgrounds who bring strong technical judgment, enterprise integration experience and responsibility for live ERP operations. 
 Why consider this opportunity? Broad ownership: Lead the complete ERP function, including people, priorities, architecture, partners and continuous improvement. Visible business impact: Improve transaction accuracy, operational efficiency, financial processing and the reliability of business-critical systems. Meaningful technical challenges: Work with high transaction volumes and integrations connecting commerce, warehouse, order-management and payment platforms. Leadership scope: Develop a capable team, strengthen delivery standards and work closely with senior Finance, Operations and Technology stakeholders. Regional exposure: Support a business operating across GCC markets, with the complexity of multiple companies, countries and currencies. 
 What you will own ERP leadership and roadmap: Lead functional, technical and support resources; set priorities, technical standards and clear accountability. Architecture and scalability: Guide solution design, challenge proposed customisations and ensure the platform remains maintainable, secure and capable of supporting business growth. Production reliability: Lead incident resolution, root-cause analysis and permanent fixes for recurring problems. Enterprise integrations: Oversee integrations with warehouse, order-management, e-commerce, payment and other operational platforms. Transaction integrity: Work with connected-system owners to ensure transactions are processed completely, accurately and on time, supported by reconciliation and exception controls. Development and releases: Oversee configuration, development, extensions, testing, deployments and upgrades. Performance and automation: Improve monitoring, background processing, exception handling and system performance while reducing manual work. Finance and operational processes: Strengthen support for Finance, Procurement, Inventory and Supply Chain, including reconciliations and month-end activities. Team and partner capability: Manage Microsoft partners and consultants, develop internal expertise and improve documentation and knowledge sharing. 
 The experience we are looking for Typically 12+ years of relevant ERP experience , including substantial responsibility within the Microsoft Dynamics ERP ecosystem. Candidates with fewer years and strong evidence of leadership, technical depth and delivery capability will also be considered. Experience leading an ERP team, Dynamics practice, technical delivery function or complex ERP programme. Ownership of live ERP environments, including support, releases, performance and operational continuity. Strong understanding of business processes across Finance, Procurement, Inventory and Supply Chain. The ability to evaluate solution architecture, challenge technical recommendations and translate business requirements into practical delivery priorities. Experience managing enterprise integrations and addressing transaction failures, data discrepancies and reconciliation issues. Strong stakeholder management, vendor management and team-development skills, supported by clear English communication. Business Central / NAV experience is strongly preferred, but its absence will not automatically exclude an otherwise strong candidate. Candidates from other Dynamics ERP platforms should demonstrate how they would build the platform-specific knowledge needed to lead this environment effectively. Technical and operational strengths that will help you succeed 
 Relevant experience may include: APIs, enterprise integration patterns and reliable transaction processing. Background jobs, scheduling, queues and automation. Monitoring, logging, exception management and root-cause analysis. SQL Server or database-performance analysis, where relevant to the deployment. Development governance, testing, release management and upgrade planning. Business Central architecture, AL development and extensions, for candidates with direct platform experience. You do not need to have used every technology listed. We are interested in your technical judgment, the complexity of the environments you have managed and the results you have delivered. Particularly relevant backgrounds Experience in e-commerce, retail, distribution, FMCG, food delivery or other high-volume transaction businesses will be valuable. Candidates from Microsoft Dynamics partners and consulting organisations are also encouraged to apply, especially where their responsibilities have included ongoing production support, enterprise integrations and operational improvement. We welcome applications from ERP managers, solution architects, Dynamics practice leaders and technical or functional delivery leaders ready to take ownership of a complete ERP function. 
 Apply Please submit an updated CV highlighting: The Dynamics products you have worked with and your level of responsibility. Teams, partners and production environments you have led. Major integrations and operational challenges you have managed. Measurable improvements in reliability, processing speed, automation, reconciliation or financial operations. Please include your current location and willingness to relocate to Kuwait or Saudi Arabia. Selection will consider the overall strength of your experience, leadership, technical judgment and business understanding. Further details about the employer and operating environment will be shared confidentially with shortlisted candidates.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO) For Quick Service Restaurant (QSR)
description:
About the Organisation Our client is a fast-growing food and beverage brand specialising in serving travellers through quick-service food outlets located at railway stations and bus terminals. The organisation operates a differentiated business model that enables passengers to order food and receive seat delivery using their PNR details. With an established presence across 11 outlets in Kerala and strategic partnerships with state transport corporations, the organisation is entering its next phase of expansion. Four additional outlets are planned on Southern Railway platforms in November 2026, with further expansion into Karnataka and Gujarat. The organisation is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Chief Operating Officer (COO) to lead its operations and drive the next phase of growth. Role Overview The COO will take complete ownership of day-to-day operations across all outlets and build scalable systems, processes and teams to support the organisation's growth from 11 outlets to 30+ outlets. The primary objective will be to ensure operational excellence, improve outlet-level profitability, standardise processes and successfully execute expansion plans across multiple states. Key Responsibilities 1. Multi-Outlet Operations Management Oversee day-to-day operations across all existing outlets. Manage staffing, workforce planning, shift rosters, kitchen operations and customer experience. Ensure consistent service quality and operational efficiency across locations. Regularly visit outlets to monitor performance and address operational challenges. 2. Financial & Operational Performance Drive outlet-level profitability and improve overall operating margins. Monitor and optimise food costs, manpower costs and other operating expenses. Establish outlet-level P&L accountability and performance benchmarks. Identify operational inefficiencies and implement cost optimisation measures. 3. Process Development & Quality Control Develop, implement and monitor standard operating procedures (SOPs). Establish food quality, hygiene, safety and service standards. Implement consistent quality control mechanisms across all outlets. Ensure operational compliance with applicable food safety and regulatory requirements. 4. Expansion & New Outlet Launches Lead the operational launch of new outlets across railway stations and bus terminals. Ensure timely execution of new outlet openings, including infrastructure, staffing, vendor onboarding and operational readiness. Build processes that support expansion into new geographies. Manage operational integration of new outlets into the existing network. 5. Supply Chain & Vendor Management Oversee procurement, inventory management, vendor relationships and supply chain operations. Manage central kitchen operations and ensure consistency in food quality. Minimise wastage and improve inventory controls. Establish efficient sourcing and distribution systems across multiple locations. 6. Team Leadership & Development Lead and mentor area managers, outlet managers and operational teams. Establish clear performance targets and accountability mechanisms. Build a strong second-line leadership team to support geographical expansion. Drive employee productivity, training and retention. 7. MIS & Performance Monitoring Establish and monitor daily operational MIS. Track outlet-wise sales, profitability, food costs, manpower productivity and inventory. Use data-driven insights to improve operational performance. Present periodic operational and financial performance updates to the founders. 8. Strategic & Business Development Support Work closely with the founders on business expansion and operational strategy. Support the rollout and management of franchise operations. Build and maintain relationships with railway authorities, state transport corporations and other strategic partners. Support the development of scalable operating models for future growth. Desired Candidate Profile Minimum 6+ years of experience in Food & Beverage, QSR, hospitality or restaurant operations. Proven experience managing multiple outlets or handling area-level operations. Demonstrated ability to improve food costs, labour costs and outlet-level profitability. Experience in launching and managing new outlets. Strong understanding of supply chain, inventory management and vendor operations. Experience in developing SOPs and implementing operational controls. Strong analytical skills with proficiency in MS Excel, POS systems and operational MIS. Excellent leadership, team management and problem-solving abilities. Willingness to travel extensively across Kerala and other states. Comfortable with hands-on operational responsibilities, including early morning and late-night outlet visits. Language Requirements Malayalam Preferred. English – Mandatory. Hindi / Kannada – Added advantage. Compensation & Benefits Fixed Compensation: 12 LPA. ESOPs with a 3-year vesting schedule. Opportunity to work directly with the founders. Senior leadership position with ownership of a rapidly expanding multi-location business. Opportunity to build and lead operations across multiple states. Ideal Candidate We are looking for a hands-on operations leader who has successfully managed multi-outlet F&B or QSR businesses and understands what it takes to build profitable, scalable operations. The ideal candidate should combine strategic thinking with strong ground-level execution and be comfortable taking complete ownership of business operations.

title: Logistics Executive - Female
description:
Greetings from Xelentra!! 
 
 One of Indias Top Manufacturing Indian MNC Client in Thennampalayam Location Is On The Look out For 
 
 Logistics Executive - Female 
 
Qualification: Any Graduate
Age: 25 - 30 Years
Experience: 3- 5 Years
Location: Thennampalayam, Arasur
Number of Vacancies: 3
Package: 3.00 Lacs - 4.00 Lacs - Negotiable 
Looking For Immediate Joiners 
 
Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Logistics & Import/Export Executive to manage domestic logistics coordination, support import and export activities, maintain shipment documentation, and ensure timely processing of freight and transportation bills. The candidate will coordinate with internal departments, transporters, freight forwarders, shipping lines, and vendors to ensure smooth and efficient logistics operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Import & Export Coordination 
Possess basic knowledge of import and export activities, shipping procedures, and related documentation.
Follow up with freight forwarders and shipping lines for shipment status, arrival updates, and freight bills.
Maintain shipment-wise import and export files and ensure proper documentation and record keeping.
Domestic Logistics Management
Coordinate domestic inbound and outbound shipments, including
pickup arrangements, delivery schedules, and transporter follow-ups.
Monitor shipment movements and coordinate with transporters to ensure timely pickup and delivery.
Liaise with internal departments and external logistics partners to resolve shipment-related issues.
 
 ERP & Documentation 
Ensure accurate and timely entry of shipment and logistics details into the ERP system.
Maintain proper shipment records, logistics documentation, and supporting documents.
Ensure all relevant records are updated and readily available for reference and audit purposes.
 
 Freight & Transport Bill Processing 
Submit transport and freight bills to the Finance Department within the stipulated timelines, along with the necessary supporting documents.
Maintain records of freight invoices, payment submissions, and pending bills.
Follow up with the concerned departments and vendors regarding bill discrepancies, pending invoices, and payment status.
Coordination & Reporting
Coordinate with internal departments, transporters, freight forwarders, shipping lines, and vendors to ensure smooth logistics operations.
Track shipment progress and provide timely updates to the concerned stakeholders.
Support the logistics team in maintaining operational efficiency and ensuring compliance with company procedures.
 
 Required Skills & Competencies 
Basic understanding of import and export procedures and shipping documentation.
Good coordination and follow-up skills.
Basic knowledge of ERP systems and MS Office, particularly Excel.
Strong documentation, record-keeping, and organizational skills.
Ability to track shipments and manage multiple activities simultaneously.
Good verbal and written communication skills. Eligibility Criteria
Any graduate with 25 years of relevant experience in logistics, shipping, transportation, or import/export coordination.
Candidates with basic knowledge of freight billing, shipment documentation, and ERP data entry will be preferred.
 
 Interested and Relevant Talents Send Your Updated CV to My Mail id hr@xelentra.in 
 and Contact Akilabalan @ 98940 40086 
 
Regards

description:
You will own US and European brands that advertise on Amazon, and be the person their founders call. You need a track record of keeping and growing B2B clients, and you need to be at home with numbers. 
 Not a fit if your work is mainly new-business sales, support tickets, consumer (B2C) customers, or running your own company's Amazon or ad accounts. Shift runs until 12:30 AM IST. 
 About us GetGrowth Digital is an e-commerce advertising agency for brands in North America and Europe. We have managed more than USD 40MM in ad spend. Fully remote team. Your mission Onboard new clients and own delivery and quality on their accounts. Build the strategy that grows each client's sales and profit. Keep clients happy, and keep them with us. Become the person clients trust on all things Amazon. What you will do Run weekly and biweekly calls with clients in the US and Europe. Build a growth plan for each client based on their goals, and work with our team to deliver it. Analyse each client's business in depth: what happened, why, and where the next opportunity is. Turn it into clear recommendations and action plans. Answer client questions in plain language, with an example and a number. Recommend next steps, back them with data, and respect the client's final call. Plan and lead key projects such as product launches, Prime Day and the holiday season. Send accurate weekly and monthly reports, written for business owners, that lead with one clear insight. Spot early signs that a client is unhappy, and find opportunities to help them grow. Must-haves 3+ years owning existing B2B clients as their main contact, in account management, consulting or client success, with results you can show: retention, renewals or account growth. Strong with numbers and data: spreadsheets, percentages, margins and forecasts. Fluent spoken English with global clients, and clear writing a busy founder reads once and understands. You can tell a client something they do not want to hear, show them the number, and keep the relationship. Comfortable with a remote shift aligned with US business hours, ending at 12:30 AM IST. You have worked remotely before: you work without someone checking in, write updates nobody has to chase, and stay reachable during shift hours. You learn fast. When something is new to you, like Amazon Ads, you go and learn it. Good to have Amazon Advertising or Seller Central experience. Client success or account management at an e-commerce, SaaS or agency business. Experience with clients in the US, UK or Europe. You do not need to be an Amazon ads expert. Ad skills alone are not enough; client ownership comes first. What we offer 90,000 to 1,10,000 a month in hand, more for an exceptional fit, plus health insurance. A fully remote role. A small team where you own real client relationships from your first quarter. Training and the tools to do the job well. As we grow, a path to lead the Client Success team. title: Solution Advisor Associate - SAP Academy For Customer Success
description:
Number Work Area: Presales Expected Travel: 0 - 10% Career Status: Graduate Employment Type: Regular Full Time Career Level: T1 Hiring Manager: Kristen Grietzer Recruiter Name: Priya Kumari 

 Job Summary 
 A Solution Advisor works closely with our customers and prospects to identify and solve business challenges and meet their strategic objectives using SAP solutions. As part of the sales team, a Solution Advisor is the 'subject matter expert' responsible for the functional and technical knowledge within the sales cycle. A Solution Advisor provides deal support by participating in discovery sessions, executive meetings and presentations and delivers software demonstrations that help the customer understand SAP's unique value proposition. In addition to deal support, the Solution Advisor participates in marketing events to generate demand, leads Design Thinking sessions, and collaborates with the broader sales team to identify whitespace opportunities at existing accounts. 

 What You'll Do 
 As a Solution Advisor within the SAP Next Gen - Academy for Customer Success, you will be responsible to: Successfully complete a 10-month program that strengthens the foundation for a successful customer-facing career at SAP. Participate in experiential learning opportunities with colleagues from all over the world and acquire a wide variety of business, industry and SAP solution skills while working with emerging and cutting-edge technologies. Receive on-the-job training under the mentorship of a senior Solution Advisor colleague while working with our customers to gain real world experience and acquire the skills necessary to help guide our customers through their Digital Transformation journey. The program will enrich your knowledge of SAP and give you the professional experience to serve our customers. We offer full-time employment from day one with practical learning applications for your role. After successful completion of the program, you are expected to lead customer discovery sessions and survey activities to uncover business challenges and opportunities for innovation. You will create and deliver high impact and engaging software demonstrations that compel the customers to select SAP over other competitive offerings. You will also provide demand generation support through marketing events and deal execution support by responding to request for proposals 

 What You Bring 
 2-3 years of professional experience with a strong foundation in technical and business processes, exposure to relevant technologies/solutions, and customer-facing skills. Technical and business process knowledge, combined with hands-on experience using relevant technologies and industry-standard tools to support solution delivery and operational efficiency. A cooperative and productive approach to working relationships, internally and externally. A strong ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to changing environments, and apply knowledge to deliver results. An understanding of AI fundamentals, uses, and ethics, to identify business problems solvable with AI. Strong Business Acumen, including demonstrated knowledge of business processes and/or industries. Proficiency in English to engage with our global network. AI focus areas: (AI Adoption Mindset, Agentic AI Day-to Day Practice, and Context Engineering) A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Strong problem-solving, project management, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively. Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement. A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, paired with a results-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative.

Key Skills: SAP,Intelligence,Demand generation,Transformation,Generation,Customer focus,Presales,Cloud Applications

title: Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
About Skypoint Skypoint is a HITRUST r2-certified Agentic AI platform for healthcare operations, designed to accelerate productivity and operational efficiency across healthcare organizations. Our platform enables healthcare providers, payers, and senior care organizations to unify fragmented data, model industry-specific ontologies, and deploy AI agents that automate workflows and support better, faster decision-making. Founded in 2020 in Portland, Oregon, Skypoint has grown to a team of over 75 employees and now serves more than 100 customers. We are proud to be recognized on Deloitte s 2024 and 2025 Technology Fast 500 , celebrating the fastest-growing technology companies in North America, and to be featured on the INC. 5000 list in 2025, reflecting our strong and sustained revenue growth over the past three years. Role Overview We are looking for a creative, versatile, and detail-oriented Product Designer (UI/UX & Marketing Design) who is passionate about building intuitive digital experiences and creating compelling visual communication materials. As a Product Designer, you will be responsible for designing end-to-end user experiences across our SaaS and AI-powered products. In addition to product design, you will also own the creative design requirements for marketing and branding initiatives. You will work closely with product managers, developers, marketing teams, and business stakeholders to translate ideas into engaging digital experiences and impactful marketing creatives. This role requires someone who can seamlessly switch between designing complex SaaS applications and creating visually appealing marketing collateral. Key Responsibilities Own the end-to-end UI/UX design process, from understanding requirements and user research to wireframing, prototyping, and final design delivery. Design intuitive, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces for SaaS and AI-powered applications. Translate complex workflows, data, and AI-driven functionalities into simple and seamless user experiences. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs. Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to understand business requirements and deliver effective design solutions. Build and maintain design systems, reusable components, and UI standards to ensure consistency across products. Conduct usability testing and incorporate user feedback to continuously improve product experiences. Work closely with engineering teams to ensure accurate implementation of design specifications. Stay updated with the latest UI/UX trends, AI product experiences, design tools, and emerging technologies. Take ownership of design deliverables and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced startup environment. Design marketing collaterals, promotional materials, and creative assets for various marketing initiatives. Create visually engaging promotional posters, banners, social media creatives, and digital advertisements. Design creatives for marketing campaigns, product launches, events, webinars, and corporate announcements. Develop presentations, brochures, product one-pagers, infographics, and sales enablement materials. Create branding and promotional assets for company events, conferences, and industry summits. Design website graphics, landing page visuals, email campaign creatives, and other digital marketing materials. Maintain brand consistency across all marketing and communication channels. Work closely with the marketing team to understand campaign objectives and translate them into compelling visual concepts. Required Skills & Experience 2-4 years of hands-on experience in Product Design / UI/UX Design. Mandatory experience working on SaaS products and AI-powered applications. Prior experience working in a startup or fast-paced product-based environment is a must. Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, prototyping, and design systems. Experience with graphic design and marketing creative tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Canva. Strong understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design. Experience designing complex dashboards, enterprise applications, workflows, and data-intensive interfaces. Experience creating marketing collaterals, promotional creatives, social media graphics, and campaign materials. Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, layouts, and visual storytelling. Good understanding of responsive design and accessibility standards. Strong communication, problem-solving, and creative thinking skills. A strong portfolio showcasing both SaaS/AI product design and marketing creative work is mandatory. What We Are Looking For A self-driven designer who can independently manage product and marketing design requirements. Someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup culture and can manage multiple priorities. Strong attention to detail with a passion for quality and consistency. Ability to balance creativity, usability, and business objectives. Someone comfortable with ambiguity who enjoys solving challenging design problems. A proactive team player who can collaborate across product, engineering, and marketing functions. Someone who takes complete ownership of deliverables and ensures timely execution. Work Requirements Location: Remote/Bangalore (Hybrid). Shift: EST working hours to support collaboration with our US-based teams. Flexibility to work in a dynamic, fast-paced product development environment. What We Offer: Competitive compensation with stock options Comprehensive health benefits, including OPD and gym reimbursements and mental wellness support Remote work flexibility Direct exposure to U.S.-based healthcare customers Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI, data, and healthcare technology solutions If you are passionate about designing next-generation SaaS and AI products and want to create meaningful user experiences, wed love to hear from you! Apply with your updated resume and portfolio showcasing your product design experience. Join us to be part of a dynamic team thats shaping the future with groundbreaking solutions in AI and technology, all while enjoying a supportive and inclusive workplace! Skypoint is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic

 The role will primarily focus on HR Operations, including employee onboarding, background verification, attendance management, PF registration, consultant documentation, exit formalities, and travel coordination. The individual will also provide recruitment coordination, asset management, and administrative support as required. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management Manage end-to-end joining formalities, including employee ID and email creation, HRMS onboarding, and employee master data updates. Maintain employee records, including PAN, Aadhaar, bank account, and PF details. Coordinate background verification (BGV) for freshers and experienced hires, including identity, address, court, previous employment, and UAN verification, as applicable. Coordinate HRMS onboarding and basic system training for new employees. Ensure PAN-Aadhaar linking verification for new joiners. Resolve employee queries related to reporting manager changes, bank details, attendance tracking, and other HR operational matters. Maintain and update employee mobile number trackers and other HR records. 
 2. Payroll & Statutory Compliance Support Coordinate PF registration for new joiners and facilitate UAN generation. Assist with consultant salary processing, including TDS deduction coordination. Prepare and maintain consultant agreements, ensuring the necessary documentation and approvals are in place. Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders for HR documentation and compliance-related activities. 
 3. Leave, Attendance & Exit Management Monitor and process attendance regularization requests in accordance with company policies. Manage employee exit formalities, including exit interviews and deactivation of email, Keka, DICE, and other applicable system access. Coordinate full and final (F&F) settlement documentation and follow up with reporting managers, HODs, Accounts, and other stakeholders. Ensure timely completion of employee offboarding formalities and documentation. 
 4. Travel & Administrative Coordination Coordinate domestic and international travel bookings, including train tickets, flights, hotels, and visa processing. Arrange visa documentation, including cover letters, invitation letters, payslips, ITRs, bank statements, insurance, and other supporting documents, as applicable. Coordinate office requirements such as meeting room bookings, food arrangements, and other administrative activities. Support general office administration and ensure smooth coordination of day-to-day operational requirements. 
 5. Recruitment & Hiring Coordination Support recruitment sourcing through Naukri and other relevant channels, as required. Screen resumes against job requirements and coordinate candidate shortlisting. Follow up with candidates and hiring managers to schedule interviews and facilitate the recruitment process. Maintain and update hiring trackers. Coordinate aptitude tests and candidate reporting instructions. Prepare and coordinate new-joiner announcements. 
 6. Asset Management & Employee Support Coordinate the allocation of laptops, SIM cards, ID cards, visiting cards, and other assets to employees. Maintain asset allocation records and update asset details in Keka and other applicable trackers. Coordinate asset purchases and repairs, subject to the required approvals. Manage asset retrieval and related documentation during employee exits. Coordinate the uploading of employee documents to designated platforms, including Teams. Track employee birthdays and work anniversaries and coordinate timely greetings. Manage dispatch and courier coordination for laptops, ID cards, visiting cards, and other employee-related materials. 
 7. Stakeholder Coordination & Documentation Coordinate with employees, candidates, hiring managers, HODs, Finance, Accounts, IT, and external vendors to ensure timely completion of HR processes. Maintain accurate employee records, trackers, agreements, and supporting documentation. Ensure timely follow-ups and closure of assigned tasks. Handle additional HR Operations and administrative responsibilities as assigned.
